what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Jordan in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 10736 asylum seekers from Jordan.
The United States hosts the largest share, 34.4%, followed by Ireland, Canada and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Jordan in 2016.
The fact pack does not say why the number of asylum seekers grew in recent years.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 551 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 14273, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from Jordan are counted separately.
